The critique keeps the main P1, P3, P4, and P6 corrections; refines P2 to allow selected public metadata in embeddings; and recommends permitting curator-approved, recoverable source writeback under P5. It also distinguishes rights/reuse descriptions from delivery authorization, adds a measurable revocation contract, and suggests Meilisearch as an optional lexical challenger. These points are grounded in the [Typesense](https://typesense.org/docs/30.2/api/vector-search.html), [RightsStatements.org](https://rightsstatements.org/en/about.html), [Meilisearch](https://www.meilisearch.com/blog/typo-tolerance), and [OpenRefine](https://openrefine.org/docs/manual/reconciling/) sources.

No runtime validation or benchmark was run. The native Goal was activated and completed after saving the artifacts; elapsed time was 5 minutes 28 seconds.
